values.summary: Complete and validate preparation truth; wait for #5591 clean reviewed contract and claim narrowing; amend to the smallest disjoint product paths; implement production governed-operation and private-continuity adapters; prove all positive and negative outcomes live at one revision; delete placeholders within budget; exact-review and publish only after every gate is green.

steps.action: Prepare all six cards, design, diagram, adapter/authority matrix, complete proof contract, and disjoint preparation claim without product edits

Verify #5591 has a current clean reviewed Parity-A contract, pin its exact accepted revision, confirm its claim is narrowed or released, and use typed csdlc-bind to add only collision-free #5589 product paths
Implement production governance, Freedom Gate/AEE, delegation, resources, cancellation, agent, Shepherd, scheduler, provider, and governed-tool adapters behind the reviewed kernel contracts
Implement identity-scoped memory/private state, qualified Chronosense time, authenticated checkpoint, non-authoritative lifelog, shutdown, and restart recovery adapters

Run live multi-agent/provider/scheduler/tool positive proof and governance, delegation, cancellation, identity, time, continuity, provider, and shutdown negative proof against a configured initialized kernel
Delete or consolidate degraded and duplicate placeholders, prove zero fixture/degraded parity credit, inventory maintained COTS use, and satisfy exact source/test budgets
Run every release-gating PVF lane at one clean committed revision, obtain bounded subagent review, fix all actionable findings, revalidate, and only then prepare publication

invariants: no product implementation before current clean #5591 review truth and collision-free typed claim authority
governance and current revocation are checked before every actuation and recovery dispatch
delegation attenuates and resources, cancellation, retry, and idempotency remain bounded
provider and tool output never grants authority
citizen identity controls private state across provider sessions and restart
qualified time is monotonic and participates in authority and continuity decisions
checkpoint is the sole recovery authority and lifelog is observational only
DegradedOperationExecutor and fixtures always receive zero parity credit
no secrets, credentials, prompts, machine-local paths, or private state appear in retained evidence
all acceptance is live-process, exact-revision, non-deferred, reviewed, and green
risks: #5591 implementation commits may be mistaken for a clean reviewed contract despite absent typed review truth
broad #5591 parent-path claims may make a product claim collision unavoidable
passive governance metadata may be mistaken for gate-before-actuation
test executors or canned provider output may be mistaken for production adapters
scheduler retry or recovery may duplicate a side effect after cancellation or revocation
provider/session identifiers may accidentally become identity authority
lifelog may be misused as restore state or disclose private content
budget pressure may encourage retaining degraded placeholders or weakening proof
stop_conditions: #5591 lacks a current clean typed review record with no actionable findings
#5591 contract revision is not pinned or changes after #5589 implementation begins
typed claim amendment reports overlap with #5591, #5592, #5590, or another active issue
any adapter remains DegradedOperationExecutor-backed or only fixture/mock/metadata/library evidence is available
any required positive, negative, continuity, shutdown, budget, or exact-revision lane is skipped, deferred, degraded, nondeterministic, or failing
completion would require AWS, Runtime v2 edits, credentials in evidence, cutover/default switch, or scope owned by another parity lane
